title: Christmas and New Year Training Break
body:
Our final training night of 2026 for all teams will be Wednesday 16th December at V36, Valley Leisure Centre, at the usual training times.

There will be a two-week Christmas and New Year break, with no training on Wednesday 23rd or Wednesday 30th December.

Training resumes on Wednesday 6th January 2027:
Ages 7–16: 7pm–8pm
Seniors aged 16+: 8pm–9pm

We wish all our players, families, coaches and volunteers a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year.

Ability Not Disability.
